products.Name: Christmas Crabs
products.description: Festive crab figures wearing red and white Santa hats, with playful eye designs. A cheerful addition to a Christmas desk or seasonal display. Sold individually at $5 each.

products.Name: Christmas Tree Advent Calendar
products.description: A Christmas tree-shaped advent calendar with a gold-coloured star, turquoise frame and 24 numbered compartments. Open a door each day as you count down to Christmas. Contents shown in the image are display examples.

products.Name: Personalised Photo Ornament
products.description: A round photo ornament that turns a portrait into a decorative Christmas keepsake. Use the custom request button to discuss your photo. The image shows an illuminated example; lighting accessories are not specified.

products.Name: Hanging Name Ornaments
products.description: Decorative hanging ornaments with a name worked into the circular design. The examples show festive stars, a moon, snowflakes and a sleigh. Sold individually at $3 each. Use the custom request button to discuss your name and design.

products.Name: Snowflake Name Ornaments
products.description: Circular name ornaments with raised lettering, snowflakes and colourful frames. Use the custom request button to discuss your name and preferred design. Price is per ornament.

products.Name: Santa Hat Name Ornament
products.description: A red and white Santa hat ornament with raised name lettering and a hanging loop. Use the custom request button to discuss your name. Price is per ornament.

products.Name: Gingerbread Name Ornaments
products.description: Gingerbread character ornaments with name lettering, icing-style outlines and bow or heart details. Use the custom request button to discuss your name and character. Price is per ornament.

products.Name: Sweater Name Ornaments
products.description: Red Christmas sweater ornaments with raised name lettering, reindeer and snowflake details. The knitted-style texture makes a festive keepsake for the tree. Sold individually at $5 each. Use the custom request button to discuss your name.
